messages:
emily.k: fyi customer AcmeApp reporting intermittent 5xx and lots of 504s over the last 45m. they can reproduce with bursty traffic. attaching sample req ids and repro steps.

oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-gateway queue_overflow detected (severity: warning) — filing incident INC-3517629000

raj.patel: are they on hosted or dedicated? which model + region?

emily.k: hosted-api, region=us-west-2, model=redwood/open-13b-instruct (v2). request ids: rQd3f8, rQd3fa, rQd40b. timestamps ~ 3517626000-3517627500

sara.t: i see a spike on dashboards; p95 latency jumped then 5xxs started. observed queue_depth ~ 511/512 on some hosts

ivan.b: any response headers from gateway? we sometimes emit `x-rw-queue-depth` and `x-rw-reject-reason` on early rejects

emily.k: yes from one response:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-rw-queue-depth: 512
x-rw-reject-reason: queue_limit_reached
x-rw-host: gw-12
```

emily.k: curl the customer used to repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-13b-instruct","input":"hello","max_tokens":512}'
```
They said running ~200 concurrent connections for ~40s reproduces the issue.

raj.patel: sounds like continuous-batcher backlog / request queue saturation. can you pull host ids from traces and confirm model variant? need batcher queue size, inflight batches, and kvcache eviction rates

emily.k: trace snippet:
```
trace: gw-12 -> runner-7 -> batcher-4
batcher-4: queue_len=496 inflight_batches=3 avg_batch_payload=14
kvcache: evictions/sec=120
```

support_lead: prioritize customer comms. suggested immediate mitigation: ask customer to drop concurrency to 50 and enable fallback to smaller model. can we add a tenant routing rule temporarily?

ivan.b: yes we can add a route + rate-limit override for that tenant for 2 hrs. i'll prepare a patch. also recommend increasing dequeue rate on the affected pool if GPU headroom exists (200->300 tokens/sec)

sara.t: check if autoscaler kicked — i see no scale-up between 3517625000-3517630000

raj.patel: short-term: route tenant->open-6b and throttle client. medium: tune continuous-batching window to drain faster or reduce max queue depth (fail fast). long-term: tenant-aware adaptive shedding

emily.k: customer agreed to reduce concurrency to 40 and accept fallback. i'm starting the route change now.

oncall-bot: ACTION created: INC-3517629000 - apply tenant routing override / mitigation. assigned to ivan.b

ivan.b: patch in progress, ETA ~12m

ivan.b: patch applied: tenant routing -> open-6b, limiter=40. monitoring now.

sara.t: post-change metrics: queue_depth peaked at ~120, 5xx rate down to 0.1% over the last 5m

emily.k: customer confirms errors stopped after the change. will monitor for 2h. thanks all :tada:

support_lead: for postmortem include batching window config, queue depth thresholds, tenant traffic profile. owner: raj.patel

raj.patel: adding backlog items: implement tenant-aware shedding, better runtime warnings when kvcache thrashes, and per-tenant batch size caps

emily.k: closing thread once we hit 2h stable. last update 3517632600
